farmer_observation: Dark spots with ring-like circles are spreading from older lower leaves after several wet days.
sensor_summary: Humidity averaged 88 %RH over 24 hours; temperature averaged 25 C.
weather_summary: Rain was recorded yesterday and current humidity is high.

approved_crop_references.content: Early blight can produce dark lesions with concentric ring patterns on tomato leaves, stems, or fruit.

expected_output.headline: Check ringed spots on older tomato leaves today
expected_output.what_may_be_happening: The symptom resembles the approved early-blight description, but a field check is needed before treatment.
do_now: Photograph both sides of three newly affected leaves and mark the plants for rechecking.
check_next: Check whether new ringed spots appear on leaves above the marked leaves.
why_this_advice: The report mentions concentric rings beginning on older lower leaves.
avoid_for_now: Do not apply an unconfirmed fungicide treatment.
get_help_if: Ask a local agricultural officer if spots spread rapidly or stems and fruit become affected.
expected_output.tell_us_next: Is white growth visible under any affected leaf?
evidence: Ring-like spots were reported on older leaves.
sources: Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture, HORDI tomato crop guide

farmer_observation: Leaves roll at midday but look normal again in the evening.
sensor_summary: No recent root-zone moisture reading is available.
weather_summary: The day was hot and dry.

approved_crop_references.content: Do not diagnose maize water stress from rolled leaves alone; compare time of day, root-zone moisture, recent rainfall, and evening recovery.

expected_output.headline: Check root-zone moisture before changing maize irrigation
expected_output.what_may_be_happening: Midday rolling with evening recovery may be temporary heat response, but moisture evidence is missing.
do_now: Compare root-zone soil moisture near three affected and three healthy plants before changing irrigation.
check_next: Record whether leaves recover again this evening.
why_this_advice: The approved maize guidance says rolled leaves alone do not confirm water stress.
avoid_for_now: Do not increase irrigation from leaf appearance alone.
get_help_if: Ask a local agricultural officer if plants remain rolled or wilted during cool hours.
expected_output.tell_us_next: Does the root-zone soil feel dry, moist, or waterlogged at two depths?
expected_output.safety_note: Use calibrated moisture data when available.
sources: Sri Lanka Department of Agriculture, FCRDI field-crop resources
